lines.zh: 我在晶丛里慢慢爬，很热。
lines.en: I crawl through the crystal thicket, warm.
I move forward segment by segment.

lines.zh: 我的身体贴着地，冒着气。
lines.en: My body hugs the ground, giving off vapour.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块源石，又继续爬。
lines.en: I go around a lump of originium and crawl on.
The ground warms where I crawl.
I head toward the smell of iron.

lines.zh: 我一边爬一边抬头看你。
lines.en: I crawl while lifting my head to look at you.
My pace is slow and steady.
I squeeze between two stones.
I crawl to your feet and stop.

lines.zh: 我的尾节还在后面拖着。
lines.en: My rear segments still drag behind.

lines.zh: 我朝温暖的地方挪过去。
lines.en: I shift toward somewhere warm.
I lift my head slowly.

lines.zh: 我一路留下细细的爬痕。
lines.en: I leave a thin trail behind me.
I brush the crystal clusters with a light ring.
I follow along in your footprints.
I lie still, my segments shifting.
I steam on a sun-warmed stone.
My head is up, waiting for you to come near.
I breathe out a small puff of heat.
Ore dust lands on my back and sizzles.
I listen to the crystals ticking.
I coil slowly into a circle.
I lie on the slag, a little cooler.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进节与节之间。
lines.en: I tuck my head between segments.
I am waiting for someone to give me iron.
My vapour wavers in the air.
I breathe out slowly.
Got any iron? My belly is empty.
I look up at you, quite tame.
I see the iron in your hand.
I have only twenty-five health; I am fragile.
I crawl slowly toward the toe of your boot.

lines.zh: 我的小眼睛盯着你的手
lines.en: My tiny eyes are fixed on your hands.
You are warm; I like that.
I am hot; do not touch me too long.
Your palm is warmer than the slag.
Do not step on me; I am soft.
I curl up and tremble.
A small segment breaks off.
The pain sends me backing away.
My heat weakens at once.
I shrink into the slag with only my tail out.
I curl even tighter.
I shift away a little.
Vapour still rises from the wound.

lines.zh: 我才二十五点血，你别打。
lines.en: I only have twenty-five health; stop hitting me.
Trembling, my segments will not obey.
Iron! The smell of iron!

lines.zh: 你手里那块铁，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell that iron in your hand.
I head for your fingers.
Crouch lower; I cannot reach.
I can eat that scrap of iron.
Set it down and I will eat.
The smell of iron excites me.
What you hold is cool.
I crawl slowly toward you.
Do not pull your hand away; wait a moment.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我被推到一边。
lines.en: You bump me and I slide aside.
I press against your foot, and it is hot.
Stepped on, I curl up.
My segments click once.
You kick me away and I crawl back.

lines.zh: 我绕着你脚边转，避不开。
lines.en: I circle your feet and cannot get past.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，我退开半寸。
lines.en: We touch and I retreat half an inch.

lines.zh: 你跨过去，我从下面穿过。
lines.en: You step over, and I pass beneath.

lines.zh: 我撞到你鞋边，翻了个身。
lines.en: I hit your boot and roll over.

lines.zh: 相撞时，我的热气喷到你。
lines.en: At the impact, my heat puffs onto you.
Two oriworms do lay eggs.
I approach another slowly.

lines.zh: 我们在晶丛里挨在一起。
lines.en: We press together in the crystal thicket.

lines.zh: 我们的节互相碰了一下。
lines.en: Our segments touch.

lines.zh: 灼热的源石虫，身体一直在烫。
lines.en: A scorching Originium worm never stops burning.
This will grow more of us.
We crawl together for warmth.
I rest my head against it.
Two of us lie on the stone.
Its heat is much like mine.
I bite the iron and swallow slowly.
I hug it with my front segments.
This will feed me a while.
I drag it into a crack in the stone.
I gnaw at it little by little.
I pick it up and balance it on my head.

lines.zh: 这东西太硬，我不太咬得动。
lines.en: This is too hard; I can barely bite it.
I try everything on the ground.

lines.zh: 我爬过的石头都是烫的。
lines.en: The stones I crawl over turn hot.
I curl it under my body.
I crawl toward the smell of iron.

lines.zh: 你手里有东西，我看到了。
lines.en: You have something in your hand; I saw it.
I choose this spot by your feet.
I raise my head toward you.
This position is warm.
I begin shifting your way.
I take you for the feeder.
I fix on your palm.
The smell on you pulls at me.
I come near slowly, unafraid.
There is food in this direction.
I head for that scrap of iron.
I keep crawling toward you.
Do not go too fast; I am slow.
The ground you crossed is still warm.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来也没有用，我会爬。
lines.en: Crouching will not help; I can crawl.
I wind around your feet.
I follow your body heat.
I crawl along your footprints.
When your fingers lower, I move in.
I crawl onto your boot.

lines.zh: 你的位置我记得很清楚。
lines.en: I remember your position clearly.
I circle your boot.
I look up at you and keep crawling.
I press close and burn you a little.
My mouthparts grip your finger.
That felt like a cigarette end.
I butt your ankle with my body.
I bite, then shrink back.
Light, but very hot.
My segments scrape over you.
I stay by your boot, still burning.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的鞋，弹了一下。
lines.en: I hit your boot and bounce.
That was not really a fight.

lines.zh: 土里钻出一截发亮的东西。
lines.en: Something bright pokes out of the soil.
I crawl out from under the crystal thicket.
You see the heat haze on the ground first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地从石缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze slowly out of a crack.

lines.zh: 我落地，脚边的草被烫弯。
lines.en: I land and the grass by me curls.

lines.zh: 这一带有源石虫，睡醒了两三只。
lines.en: Orimorms live here; two or three have woken.
I raise my head and look around.
I push out of the slag heap.

lines.zh: 我的热气先到，身子后到。
lines.en: My heat arrives before my body.

lines.zh: 我一点点从黑暗里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the dark, a bit at a time.

lines.zh: 火撩过来，我本来就热，还是疼。
lines.en: Fire comes near; I am already hot, and it still hurts.

lines.zh: 我被摔下，身子弯成了两折。
lines.en: I am dropped and my body folds in two.

lines.zh: 水浇上来，我嘶嘶地冒气。
lines.en: Water hits and I hiss out steam.
The blast knocks my segments out of line.
An arrow pierces my segment and it stings.

lines.zh: 法术扫过，我的热气散了。
lines.en: A spell passes and my heat breaks up.

lines.zh: 没有铁吃，我的火气低了。
lines.en: No iron, and my inner heat sinks.
Lightning strikes and my whole body jerks.

lines.zh: 虚空吸我，我的热气被抽干。
lines.en: The void draws me in and my heat is pulled dry.
